scope: Stable timestamped observer qualification only, two fresh stdlib fixtures. No field entry/GUI/device/human/Run/optimization/ETW/interval operations.
acceptance: Every requested sample retained with real QPC begin/end after initialization; no read errors, gaps, reordered/extra records, PID/TID/owner mismatch or failed recovery. Full mapped brackets inside independently timed known phase and external controller bracket. Two anchors retain full clock uncertainty <=1ms. Zero owner is permitted only in released control. No time shares or point timestamps.
preservation: One declared attempt per mode; stop on failure, keep raw and lock. No retries to replace a failed control. Build failures precede qualification and are preserved separately.
limits: No actual-load perturbation calibration yet; cannot declare field-ready or quantitative attribution.
Read bracket includes pause/read/resume but is not GIL hold duration. Initialization/I/O/CPU contention effects also need qualification.
